items.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy fires his military chief after protests and names a new one
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy fired Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi as commander-in-chief of Ukraine's armed forces following days of protests demanding his removal. Zelenskyy appointed Mykhailo Drapatyi as the new army chief.

items.title: Ukraine's Zelensky fires military chief after protests and names a replacement
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky on Tuesday fired Gen. Oleksandr Syrsky as commander-in-chief of Ukraine’s armed forces, following days of mass protests in Kyiv and other cities nationwide demanding his removal. Zelenskyy appointed Mykhailo Drapatyi as the new army chief, according to a statement on social media.

items.title: Why so many Ukrainians are up in arms over firing of defense minister
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s dismissal of the popular defense minister, an architect of Ukraine’s effective high-tech warfare, has sparked protests across the country. More than just strategy, youth appears part of his appeal.

items.description: A direct Russian missile strike completely destroyed the manufacturing facilities and warehouses of UKRTAC, a Ukrainian producer of military gear and personal protective equipment, during an attack on Kyiv on Sunday, July 19. items.title: Russia Hits Kyiv In Massive Missile And Drone Attack
items.description: Russia launched 41 missiles and 125 drones in a massive overnight attack on Ukraine, with Kyiv as the main target. Ukrainian officials said it was Russia's largest use of ballistic missiles since the start of the full-scale invasion. At least one person was killed and 16 were injured.
